data.scope: Cached data integrity, nonempty class support and source-group separation; not legal clearance or independent garment identity.

quality.criterion: selected recipe mean selection F1 >= preset floor; fixed deployment seed does not regress more than preset tolerance against frozen baseline same seed
quality.scope: Selection data only; no test metric used to choose model or gate criterion.

temperature_fit.method: deterministic bounded golden-section log-temperature search, with T=1 guard
temperature_fit.scope: Fitted and described on calibration data only; in-sample NLL is not test calibration quality.

threshold_selection.policy: accept confidence >= threshold; maximize calibration coverage; keep confidence ties
threshold_selection.scope: Threshold chosen on calibration data; empirical target and interval are not a future accuracy guarantee.

calibration.scope: In-sample calibration fit and empirical threshold eligibility, not guaranteed future accepted accuracy.

parity.scope: CPU FP32 tensor-logit parity after choices frozen; no assessment-driven model selection.

derived_local_release.scope: Separate CPU export validation; no retraining, calibration refit or assessment-driven model selection.

local_parity.scope: CPU FP32 tensor-logit parity after choices frozen; no assessment-driven model selection.

archived_oracle_parity.scope: New ONNX CPU outputs against the unchanged archived PyTorch 2.11 CPU oracle, original batches 1/3/64.

full_assessment.scope: Numerical/serving equivalence only; original model, metric, seed and threshold choices unchanged. No calibration refit.

png_predictor.scope: PNG encoding of prepared 224px crops through actual decode/crop/preprocess/Predictor; no arbitrary-photo quality claim.

api_contract.scope: In-process HTTP ASGI contract with actual Predictor; no network deployment, uptime or production traffic.

limitations: This is an additive Windows CPU export, not a rerun in the original Colab torch2.11 environment.
Original candidate failure remains preserved. This does not retroactively change the received archive status.
Readiness is for the declared local service on preselected six-class garment crops, not production or arbitrary photos.
CPU forward timings exclude decoding, HTTP and network; use only the newly measured CPU_BENCHMARK.json.

derived_cpu_benchmark.scope: Warm CPU forward-only, input tensor already in memory; excludes decoding/transfer/network. Not service latency.

scope: A real-image extension to the five-family Fashion-MNIST assignment. Recorded studies and later CPU export validation remain separate.
limitations: Assessment is conditional on the declared data subset and cropping procedure, not smartphone-photo validation.
Seed sample SD is not uncertainty over independent datasets or garments.
Calibration temperature and threshold share one calibration partition; its selected accepted accuracy is optimistic.
Wilson intervals treat individual accepted crops as Bernoulli samples; repeated views/source groups can be dependent.
Corruptions alter already letterboxed 224px RGB arrays; these are project-specific stress tests, not an official corruption benchmark.
No human review, legal clearance, production traffic or uptime is asserted by automated passing gates.
